title: Digital security
learning_outcomes: Explain authentication and threats in the context of digital security.
Compare and distinguish passwords and MFA in the context of digital security.
Apply phishing and backups in the context of digital security.
Evaluate and justify decisions about recovery in the context of digital security.

lessons.title: Authentication and threats
lessons.outcome: Explain authentication and threats in the context of digital security.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving authentication and threats; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to fictional account security audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain authentication and threats from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of authentication and threats; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Passwords and MFA
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish passwords and MFA in the context of digital security.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving passwords and mfa; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to fictional account security audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain passwords and mfa from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of passwords and mfa; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Phishing and backups
lessons.outcome: Apply phishing and backups in the context of digital security.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving phishing and backups; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to fictional account security audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain phishing and backups from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of phishing and backups; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Recovery
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about recovery in the context of digital security.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving recovery; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to fictional account security audit.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain recovery from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of recovery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of authentication and threats; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of passwords and mfa; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of phishing and backups; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of recovery; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.

safety.notes: Draft educational framework only. Use fictional cases; no personal diagnosis, prescription, hazardous practice, financial/legal instruction or unqualified certification. Obtain qualified/local review before publication.
